cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Every Glitch Is a Gift
cards.instruction: Turn every contradiction or failure into a surprising benefit of the impossible system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two turns, like you. Picnic setting. The garden door's opened into the broom cupboard; take a brush for the crumbs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The key was sticking. Now it's the attic. I'm carrying all the sandwiches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lock freed. Grab the picnic blanket without climbing stairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's the cellar. The sandwiches are getting warm.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Built-in refrigeration. Put them beside the wine.
